root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic orientations: measured delay, gentleness, and non-hastening; and مُهْل, a viscous molten or oily substance.
root_idea.development: The verbal branch develops from treating someone gently or not hastening against him to granting respite and proceeding deliberately. A separate nominal branch denotes oil dregs or molten matter. One reported variant uses التمهّل for advancing or going forward, contrary to the ordinary sense of deliberate slowness.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form.
Displayed under the normalized Form IV perfect citation form.
Displayed as the distinct nominal مُهْل.

senses.definition: To bid someone wait; to grant respite or allow time before acting against him.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, used in the imperative for allowing the addressed people respite, including in the construction مَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ.

senses.definition: To treat someone gently by granting him delay or respite; to refrain from hastening against him.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, used in the imperative أَمْهِلْهُمْ for granting respite with gentleness or without immediate action.

senses.definition: A hot, viscous molten substance, especially the dregs or residue of oil.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in Quranic similes for a substance that boils or appears molten; the supplied lexical evidence gives oil dregs as the primary identification, while the contexts are variously rendered with murky oil or molten metal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To proceed deliberately or leisurely, without haste, in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes measured, unhurried conduct or progress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Gentleness; a calm or leisurely manner of acting or proceeding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used adverbially or imperatively in مَهْلًا, meaning to act gently, softly, or without haste.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A period or allowance of delay; a leisurely interval in which something proceeds gradually.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In an affair, denotes delay or postponement; in the expression فِي مُهْلَةٍ, can describe proceeding gently or little by little.
A reported variant usage, presented as contrary to the ordinary sense of proceeding deliberately or slowly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression غُرْمُولٌ مُتَمَهِلٌّ, a hard penis.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare anatomical descriptive expression; it should not be generalized beyond this attested phrase.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The gentle-treatment and respite branches are combined in the Form IV Quranic sense.
The imperative use is covered by the broader مَهْلٌ meaning.
Pointer-only cross-reference; substantive subunits are accounted for separately.
Delay or postponement in an affair.
Leisurely, gentle, gradual proceeding is covered by the مُهْلَةٌ entry.

cautions: The three Quranic occurrences of مُهْلٌ share one lexical sense, but the supplied evidence does not establish separate material senses for the oil-dreg and molten-metal renderings.
The reported advancement meaning of تَمَهَّلَ is variant and contrary to the ordinary deliberate or unhurried sense.
